waivers.reason: No module ships a roles file yet: the roles file has no FxTS spec to be written against, and the hub still uses its own flat roles.
The record id rule of the transport contract (T-5) is not built: records carry an id the adapter makes, and the hub does not yet keep each id once.
Store and forward is not part of the module SDK yet (T-6): the module does not buffer what it cannot deliver.
The goodbye and the last will of the transport contract (T-8) are not built: the hub learns of a shutdown only when calls stop.

metadata.state: This is Forge's own management module for this service, not an integration with another system. An existing application was the example it is built from: the Python adapter holds the data contract taken from that example (sources, context mapping, record shapes). The module's own logic, storage and screens are not built.
metadata.target: A Go module built from the module SDK, with Python scripting for customization (owner, 2026-11-18). Its source path, language and template change in this spec when that code exists.
metadata.time_contract_state: The hub database mod_cmms is declared as the rule the module is built to: every time it writes there comes from its own governed clock. The adapter does not use the database yet. M-4 to M-7 are run by the conformance kit through the Python transport, against a reference hub.
